visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with blonde hair, styled with a small braid on top, wearing a black ribbed tank top, stands in an indoor room with white walls and distinctive red shelving behind her. She holds a yellow and red lighter in her right hand and clicks it, producing a small flame while looking downwards with a neutral expression. (2) The scene cuts to a high-contrast transformation where the same woman now has long, wavy dark hair and wears a white faux-fur coat with black spots over a dark top, accessorized with a pearl necklace. She holds the lit lighter close to her face, showcasing a glamorous makeup look with bold red glossy lips, glancing confidently at the camera. (3) Close-up shots focus on the application of a black tube of lip gloss labeled 'TIME PHORIA'. The woman applies the glossy red liquid to her lips using a wand applicator, demonstrating the texture and shine. She is seen in her blonde hairstyle again, wearing a sheer patterned top, and later drinks from a purple glass to show the lip product's transfer-proof quality. (4) A montage follows showing various lip shades on her lips and arm swatches. Text overlays identify the shades while the woman poses in different outfits, including a dark-haired look with the fur coat and a blonde-haired look with a floral top. The backgrounds shift between the red-shelved studio and a soft-lit indoor setting. (5) The final sequence displays three distinct styles side-by-side: 'Mature' with dark hair and fur, 'Cute' with blonde hair and a floral top, and 'Spicy' with dark hair and a black outfit. The woman poses playfully, framing her face with her hands and holding the product, before ending with a centered shot of her in the dark-haired 'Spicy' persona.

A clear, youthful female voiceover in Mandarin begins with an enthusiastic tone. (2) As the visuals transition, a synthesized 'whoosh' effect is heard, emphasizing the cut. The narrator continues her description of the lip gloss product, maintaining a professional but friendly broadcasting style. The music bed remains constant with a repetitive melodic synth hook. (3) Periodic 'ding' sounds are heard throughout the speech, synchronized with the appearance of text overlays on the screen. The narrator's speech rate is moderate and well-enunciated. (4) The music continues to swell slightly as the narrator describes specific color shades, ending with a final bright melodic flourish in the electronic track as she asks the audience a closing question, with the vocal remaining warm and engaging.
